授業科目の概要.科目名称: 課題研究（人と社会領域）〔グローバル・ガバナンス〕
授業科目の概要.講義題目: Global Governance and Global Public Goods
授業科目の概要.対象学部等: 共創学部/School of Interdisciplinary Science and Innovation
授業科目の概要.曜日時限: 冬学期 月曜日 ２時限
授業科目の概要.授業科目に関する特筆事項: This course covers global governance issues and involves reading of texts (including excerpts of international treaties), research, presentations, discussions, and essay writing. When conducting research for group presentations and reports on various topics, students are expected to independently gather relevant literature using libraries, databases, and other resources. During group presentations, students are encouraged to consider how to structure their presentations effectively to convey their ideas to the audience within the limited time allotted. The topics covered will be drawn broadly from different policy fields of global governance, and students will select their own topics based on their interests.

授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（日本語）: 本講義では、グローバル・ガバナンスの概念を紹介し、国際的なルールや制度が、国境を越える地球規模の課題への対応をどのように形作っているかを考察します。本講義では、概念的な基礎と、気候、保健、エネルギー、貿易、平和・紛争など、グローバル・ガバナンスの概念が適用される主要分野に関する事例研究を組み合わせています。講義構成は、理論的な部分（第１・２講）から、実践的な応用分野（第3講～第7講）へと移行するよう設計されています。本講義を修了するまでに、学生は(i)グローバル・ガバナンスの概念を説明し、(ii)関与する主要な機関を特定し、(iii)様々な政策分野におけるグローバル・ガバナンスの機能を分析し、(iv)現在のグローバル・ガバナンスの枠組みのメリットと限界を評価できるようになることが期待されています。
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.授業科目の目的（英語）:
The course introduces to students the idea of global governance and examines how
international rules and institutions, shape responses to transnational, global challenges. The course combines conceptual foundations with case studies on major fields in which the global governance concept is applied, such as climate, health, energy, trade and peace/conflicts. The course is designed to transition from a theoretical part (in the first two lectures) to practical fields of application (lectures three through seven). By the end of the course, students should be able to (i) explain the concept of global governance, (ii) identify the principal institutions involved, (iii) analyze how global governance functions in different policy areas, and (iv) evaluate the strengths and limits of current global governance arrangements.
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.キーワード: Global governance; WHO; WTO; UN; Paris Agreement
授業科目の目的・目標・履修条件について.履修条件: There are no specific prerequisites. The course is designed with the understanding that undergraduate students are encountering various topics for the first time, so prior specialized knowledge is not assumed. We welcome students who are eager to engage actively in the course and contribute to in-depth discussions.

授業科目の成績評価の方法について.定期試験: Final exam in form of essay question based on the contents discussed in class (approximately 30 per cent of the final grade).
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.発表: Every student is expected to participate in an in-class group presentation (group size depends on class size, each group ideally comprises of two to four students). The performance in the group presentation will constitute approximately 30 per cent of the final grade. Topics will be discussed in class.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.授業への貢献度: The class relies on class participation. Students are expected to attend classes prepared to be able to contribute knowledgeably to our discussions. Class participation constitutes approximately 40 per cent of the final grade.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.出席: Students are expected to attend all classes. In case of non-attendance, please be sure to give prior notice and provide a reason.
授業科目の成績評価の方法について.備考: Consultation is possible before or after classes, or by e-mail. You may also visit the office/lab for a consultation after having scheduled an appointment.
